description: Private taskless associative Memory Network lifecycle hooks. SessionStart receives only append-only additions after the local commit cursor and flushes queued episodes in bounded batches. UserPromptSubmit recalls related visible evidence from the private local index without network access or task matching. Stop queues one immutable visible episode and one continuity edge, attempts a small publication, and replays at most once after a disjoint concurrent advance. Conversations and tasks are provenance only: hooks never bind, route, move CURRENT, or ask for a numbered task choice. Semantic decisions, preferences, corrections, progress, supersessions, conflicts, and resolutions remain append-only AI-inferred edges anchored to visible evidence. Credentials, native conversation IDs, hidden reasoning, tool traces, and local absolute paths are excluded, and publication requires a verified private control plane.
